integrity: Analytic local expansion and two-dimensional sublevel-volume calculations; deterministic exact-chord numerical checker is supplementary, not a replacement for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise fixed-shape asymptotic for two independent Euclidean-arclength endpoints. No uniform p/epsilon crossover, increasing-sample extreme-value theorem, or independent validation. The astroid and diamond special cases are not independently claimed as new.
title: Five near-diameter regimes for arclength-random chords of Lamé curves
